name: AmmonRa
biography: is a former dev who now works in infosec as a pentester. Both at work and in his spare time AmmonRa hacks things. As well as hacking computers, AmmonRa is a DIY cyborg, designing and implanting in himself a range of devices, including NFC/RFID chips, biometric sensors and subdermal lights.
